verdict.rationale: Kong Gateway supports a Declarative Databaseless Deployment mode and a Docker DB-less install that can run entirely locally without any cloud/Konnect account, and decK provides local declarative config management (kong-gh-4, kong-gh-7/20, kong-docs-4). However, Kong's own quickstart flow actually provisions a Control Plane in Konnect (cloud) by default (kong-docs-45), and most workspace/catalog/MCP-management features are Konnect-only SaaS capabilities, so full offline local-only usage requires bypassing the recommended path. Missing for 10: explicit first-party guide for a fully offline local workspace, confirmation that all developer workflows (not just gateway proxying) work without any Konnect account, independent hands-on validation of offline mode.
